'''Thendys Noori''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]], Thendys Noori was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], serving as the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kellian Jarro]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the Cold War Master Jarro was listed as the final [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] target for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] vying for the prize. The first bounty hunter who tried to kill her Master was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] named [[Tarro Blood]], who was quickly subdued by a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]]. Held under questioning, Blood claimed that another [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] was his accomplice and was en route and Jarro believed him.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameDS}}
[[File:Jarro_and_Noori.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Thendys Noori contemplates the body of her dead master Kellian Jarro.]]
Soon enough, a [[D5-Mantis Patrol Craft]] emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and was caught by the [[Aurora (CR90 corvette)|''Aurora'']]{{'s}} [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. The security teams attempted to arrest the hunter for terrorism but the hunter simply fought through the entire ship before reaching Noori and her Master on the bridge. Jarro demanded that the hunter surrender, before attempting another mind trick, only to discover that his opponent had a much stronger will than the weak-minded Blood. He then attempted reasoning, acknowledging that the Mandalorians wanted him dead but there is no profit in revenge. The hunter refused to care and attacked Jarro. Noori watched helplessly as her Master was slain and, stricken by grief, urged the hunter to kill her so as to spare her the shame of failing her master. Her Master's killer was happy to oblige her and slew the girl.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay alternatives===
During the mission onboard the ''Aurora'', the player can either choose to spare Thendys Noori (light side points) or kill her (dark side points).<ref name="TOR" /> If the former is chosen, Noori sends a message to the Grand Champion, informing them of having been calmed down by the Jedi and encouraged the bounty hunter to abandon their career.<ref name="TOR:Tyi">{{TORcite|type=message|Turn yourself in|Thendys Noori}}</ref> She later turns up on [[Quesh]], leading a strike team to apprehend the Hunter. She does this under the supervision of [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]], convincing him that the Champion would surrender peacefully. She reminds the Champion that they spared her life, which the courts would take into consideration if the Champion surrendered. She is soon killed in the ensuring battle. If Noori is executed, another Jedi Knight, [[Tyler Thello]], will take her place during the Quesh mission.<ref name="TOR:Endorsement">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Endorsement|Quesh}}</ref>
